title: 재외공관 무관주재령 / queue:ARTICLE:6:0:00006:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 6 (Senior Military Attaché)
(1) Where two or more military attachés are stationed at the same diplomatic mission abroad, the person designated as the defense attaché by the Minister of National Defense shall be the senior military attaché, who shall direct and supervise the other military attachés under the direction and supervision of the head of mission or the Minister of National Defense under Article 4.
(2) The Minister of National Defense may designate other military attachés subject to the direction and supervision of the senior military attaché under paragraph (1) as military affairs officers or assistant military attachés.
